label: VERIFIED
extraction: Ralph Workflow cost arbitrage applied to AI coding workflows: expensive model only runs where reasoning adds value. Pipeline pattern: 1) Plan - strong reasoning model defines scope, acceptance criteria, 'done' definition, 2) Build - fast coding model implements against spec in isolated workspace, 3) Verify - second model (or same with different prompting) reviews diff, runs checks, flags issues, 4) Fix - targeted corrections on flagged items with tight loop ceiling to prevent drift. Cheap model handles bulk implementation. Each phase produces reviewable artifact next phase can judge. Not about more agents, but clear phase boundaries. Inspired by humanplane style RFC decomposition patterns (reference for ralphinho-rfc-pipeline).
